title: Where an idea Finding goes at triage

rows.label: Idea Finding: 'show the plan's cost per day'
A: becomes a proposal card, Finding closed
B: won't-fix unless Lee picks it
C: stays triaged, loop ignores ideas
Loop can finish once bugs and follow-ups are done

example: Today: 12 bugs closed, 1 idea at 'triaged' -> index exits 1, loop never ends.
Any of A, B or C lets it exit 0.
